test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: Six boys are sitting in a row facing North. Kamal is immediate left of Ankit. Chetan is seating exactly in between Rajan and Ronak. There are two people seated between Rajan and Ankit, who is separated from Mohan by one person. If Rajan is seated at one end of the row, then who is at the other end?
solution:
Persons: Ankit, Mohan, Rajan, Kamal, Ronak, and Chetan 

1) There are two people seated between Rajan and Ankit, who is separated from Mohan by one person.

2) Rajan is seated at one end of the row

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bbce923e6c136811a669fcc8b2e6192ced59a985c94d18bb587c0553e53b6f4.png] 

3) Kamal is to the left of Ankit. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c25a01b083ada6e64a30cf51b76a2d25a8ad0a0c6de7a787577b481ab3d73bc.png] 

 

4) Chetan is seating exactly in between Rajan and Ronak. Case 2a and 2b became invalid

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/99a7f07f2c4e97b22a6f837acbb5bf7231f7ee284d6b6028207f00269bcc8d98.png] 

Hence, **Mohan** is sitting at the other end.
